A '''member''' of the [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] [[Species/Legends|species]] worked as a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. An abusive individual, the mercenary was [[Death/Legends|killed]]<ref name="Codex" /> in [[3660 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> by an eight-[[Standard year/Legends|year]]-old [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] child named [[Akaavi Spar]]. The [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|girl]] used an improved [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]] to kill the Abyssin, earning her the nickname "firehand" among her [[Clan Spar|clan]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Abyssin mercenary was first mentioned in the Codex entry for Akaavi Spar in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
